purpose: Public explanatory copy only. Tier, availability and maturity remain owned by install-packages.json.

topics.where: Your project’s development chat and test results.
topics.request: Use BOS to check the sign-in and saving workflow. First tell me which checks you can run; do not change anything.
topics.expect: A proposed check plan, results for checks actually run, and anything still untested.
topics.limits: A reusable validation installation is being prepared. A check plan is not a completed test.
topics.keywords: test app check login sign in save testing
topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.
topics.plain_summary: Check how your app handles sign-in, saving and other important actions.

topics.where: Screens and user journeys in the app you are building.
topics.request: Use BOS to review this screen for confusing wording, navigation and mobile usability. Show findings before changing it.
topics.expect: Specific observations, suggested improvements and the checks needed after a change.
topics.limits: The reusable package is being prepared. This is not an accessibility certification.
topics.keywords: design ux ui mobile accessible screen usability
topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.
topics.plain_summary: Look for confusing screens, awkward steps and accessibility problems.

topics.where: Your project’s code, rules and targeted tests.
topics.request: Use BOS to review the recurring dates in this project. Identify the boundary cases and supported checks first.
topics.expect: The rules being checked, edge cases and evidence from supported tests.
topics.limits: The reusable installation is being prepared; compatible tools and project approval are still required.
topics.keywords: dates time recurring recurrence rules logic
topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.

topics.where: Your project’s release plan and supporting checks.
topics.request: Use BOS to review what is still missing before this app’s beta launch. Do not publish anything.
topics.expect: Missing checks, practical release risks and a next step.
topics.limits: A reusable package is being prepared. A review does not approve a release or certify compliance.
topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.

topics.where: Your app’s permissions, data boundaries and security checks.

topics.keywords: security login permissions access auth roles tenant
topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.

topics.where: Billing and feature-access code in the app you are building.

topics.where: Your project’s development records and supported test tools.
topics.request: Use BOS to explain what changed in the last task, which checks ran and what remains unverified.

topics.where: Saved decisions and development records for this project.

topics.installation_note: This entry does not offer a ready-to-install package.

topics.where: Connections to AI services used by your app’s features.

topics.where: Notification code, settings and delivery services for your app.
